question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**accordingly**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• After reading the **passage** we get an idea that the passage is based on **competition** and how a **student tackles** it.
 
• The suitable word which best suits is '**accordingly**'. 
 
• After adding the word in sentence **Students must be aware of the tough environment they are entering and prepare accordingly in order to improve their chances.**

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

Let's look at the other words,

 
• **Reluctantly:** not willing to do something.
 
• **Consequently:** as a result.
 
• **Exponentially:** more and more rapidly.
